overview_description.description:
Truemeds is a telehealth platform that makes healthcare accessible to every patient. It advises patients about substitute medicines offered by reputed pharmaceutical companies and recommends appropriate value medicines to customers with precise scientific matching and outcome history.

Co-founded in 2019 by Akshat Nayyar and Kunal Wani. the company is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
